xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheAuthority: Deputy Commissioner (ST) III, GST, Large Taxpayers Unit, Chennai -35
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak:
The Company has received an Order in Form DRC-07 dated 22nd December 2025, issued under Section 73 of the TNGST Act, 2017. The Order confirms the demand towards denial of Input Tax Credit on supplies received from defaulting vendors for the financial year 2021-22, including cases where the vendors either did not file their GSTR-3B returns or filed the returns as “NIL”.
The tax demand amounts to Rs. 1.99 lacs, along with interest of Rs. 1.58 lacs and a penalty of Rs. 0.40 lac.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: There is no material impact on financial, operations or other activities of the Company arising out of such Order.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheAuthority: Deputy Commissioner (ST) III, GST, Large Taxpayers Unit, Chennai -35
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak:
The Company has received an Order in Form DRC-07 dated 22nd December 2025, issued under Section 73 of the TNGST Act, 2017. The Order confirms the following demands: (i) disallowance of tax reduced through GST credit notes issued to customers, on account of non-submission of certificates evidencing reversal of input tax credit by the customers; and (ii) levy of interest on tax payable on value increased through debit notes issued pursuant to upward price revisions, calculated from the date of original supply till the date of issuance of such debit notes.
The total tax demand amounts to Rs. 18.92 lacs, along with interest of Rs. 16.54 lacs and a penalty of Rs.2.08 lacs.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: There is no material impact on financial, operations or other activities of the Company arising out of such Order.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheAuthority: Deputy Commissioner (ST) III, GST, Large Taxpayers Unit, Chennai -35
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak:
The Company has received an Order in Form DRC-07 dated 24th December 2025, issued under Section 73 of the TNGST Act, 2017. The Order disallows Input Tax Credit on the following grounds: (i) transport services provided to employees; (ii) other alleged ineligible supplies such as air travel, hotel accommodation, etc., provided to Company executives during official visits; and (iii) levy of interest on delayed payment of GST on invoices liable under the Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM).
The tax demand amounts to Rs. 33.07 lac, along with interest of Rs. 22.06 lac and a penalty of Rs. 3.45 lac.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: There is no material impact on financial, operations or other activities of the Company arising out of such Order.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak:
The Company has received an Order dated 26th December 2025 pursuant to the GST Audit for FY 2021–22, passed under Sections 73 of the MGST/CGST Act, 2017 read with Section 20 of the IGST Act, 2017. The Order confirms the demand on the following grounds: 1. Excess outward tax liability reported in GSTR-1 as compared to tax paid in GSTR-3B. 2. Non-reversal of Input Tax Credit (ITC) in GSTR-3B as compared to disclosures made in GSTR-9.
The tax demand amounts to Rs.14.25 lac, along with interest of Rs. 11.20 lac and a penalty of Rs. 1.42 lac. Appeal will be filed on or before 23.03.2026 to the Joint Commissioner of Commercial Taxes (Appeals) challenging theTax Credit and imposition of Interest and Penalty.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: There is no material impact on financial, operations or other activities of the Company arising out of such Order.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheAuthority: Deputy Commissioner SECTOR 5, State GST, HARIDWAR
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak:
The Company has received an Order dated 30th December 2025, issued under the relevant provisions of the GST law, confirming the demand raised during the assessment for the financial year 2021-22 on account of incorrect Place of Supply (POS) reported by the supplier in GSTR-1.
The tax demand amounts to Rs. 39.59 lac, along with interest of Rs. 30.09 lac and a penalty of Rs. 3.95 lac.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: There is no material impact on financial, operations or other activities of the Company arising out of such Order.
